main.description: One taco-eating event, recorded by the eater. A person's running total is the sum of `count` across every log record in their own repo — see public/lib/tally.js. Written and read by tacocounter (https://tacocounter.bisks.net).

count.description: How many tacos were eaten in this sitting.

note.description: Optional short note — what kind, where, with who.

eatenAt.description: When these tacos were eaten, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
